name: Sindhu Dharshan Yatra Scheme 2016
benefit:
1. The financial assistance will be provided up to the extent of ₹10,000/- or 50% of the actual expenditure per person whichever is less.
   1. Financial assistance shall be provided to a maximum of 50 (fifty) numbers of pilgrims.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Haryana State.
   1. The applicant/pilgrim should complete the Yatra through the State Govt./Central Govt./Society and the completion certificate in this regard must be submitted by the State/Central Govt./Society.
   1. The financial assistance shall be given only once to a pilgrim.
